name: kb
description: Compile a repository's raw notes into a durable, committed knowledge base in Open Knowledge Format

interface.shortDescription: Compile raw notes into a committed knowledge base
interface.longDescription: One skill, kb:compile, which reads the raw corpus under thoughts/ and writes a durable knowledge base under docs/ in Open Knowledge Format v0.2, with per-source provenance hashes so drift is detectable. Invoke it manually as $kb:compile; it never auto-triggers. The plugin ships no subagents, so there is no install script to run. It requires no other plugin.
defaultPrompt: Compile my notes into the knowledge base
